Priya: Quick report — after upgrading to py-sdk v0.9.7 our FastAPI sample shows background inference (spawned with asyncio.create_task) breaking trace correlation. OTEL shows separate root span; logs don't contain x-request-id. Anyone seen this pattern?

Ethan: Yep saw similar in e2e. Are you using client.install_observability_hooks() or adding the middleware on the ASGI app? Theres a subtle ordering issue if hooks are installed after auth or retry layers.

Priya: I called install_observability_hooks exactly as in the README: client = RedwoodClient(...); client.install_observability_hooks(); then mounted the client in app state. Handler:
```python
@app.post('/infer')
async def infer(req: Request):
    out = await client.generate(prompt)
    asyncio.create_task(client.generate(prompt, background=True))
    return out
```
Background call lacks traceparent and our custom `x-request-id`.

Riley: Two places to check: (1) context propagation across asyncio.create_task (contextvars not auto-copied in some spawn patterns), (2) our async retry path — older code spun up a new httpx.AsyncClient per retry attempt and didn't propagate the original request headers.

Priya: I'm on uvicorn+uvloop, python 3.11. Using our sample app from docs with small edits.

Ethan: Quick repro: try wrapping the task with contextvars.copy_context().run:
```python
import contextvars, asyncio
ctx = contextvars.copy_context()
asyncio.get_event_loop().create_task(ctx.run(client.generate, prompt))
```
If that keeps the trace, it's definitely context capture. If not, check headers in the outgoing HTTP request (enable DEBUG logging for httpx).

Priya: I tried that and traceparent was preserved. So root cause is create_task losing context. However, the retry bug is real too — when I force a 429 our retries show new traces without the original trace id.

Riley: I'll open a small PR to: (A) expose client.spawn_with_context helper that captures context and starts tasks, (B) modify retry logic to reuse the request headers and run propagator.inject before each attempt.

qa: Please also add an integration test: fastapi -> spawn_with_context -> cause retry -> OTLP exporter should show single trace id across all spans. That will prevent regressions.

Priya: Filed issue with sample and logs: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/512 — includes failing trace screenshot and a tiny sample app.

ops-bot: CI: test-observability (build #204) queued for branch fix/propagate-context.

Ethan: For docs: add a short note in observability guide about async spawn patterns and recommend using the helper or contextvars.copy_context as a stopgap. Also call out middleware ordering: install_observability_hooks before wiring auth/retry.

Riley: Drafting PR now; will include a small snippet for the SDK docs:
```python
# recommended
await client.install_observability_hooks()
# inside request handler
await client.generate(...)
# spawn background work preserving context
client.spawn_with_context(client.generate, prompt)
```

Priya: Thanks — I'll smoke-test the branch on our sample app and report results. :thumbsup:
